verdict.rationale: The UK IPO runs digital services for searching, filing, tracking and renewing IP, so a built-in AI assistant is a plausible capability and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI assistant, chatbot or agentic task delegation; the documented channels are online forms, search tools, email and post.
